name: Warm Tooltip
description: Tooltip that wraps any element and appears on hover, focus or touch long-press. Once one is open, neighbouring tooltips open instantly and glide between triggers in a shared bubble.
contents: Wrapper around a single child element that acts as the trigger
Floating tooltip bubble with text or node content, optional keyboard shortcut chip and optional arrow
Optional fuse line showing the open delay progress next to the trigger
Optional WarmTooltipGroup export to share timing across several tooltips
behavior: Cold hover opens after a delay with a scale, rise and blur pop
While a tooltip is open or just closed (warm window), hovering another trigger opens at once and the bubble springs to the new position and size
Content cross-fades with a small slide and blur when switching triggers
Keyboard focus-visible opens instantly, Escape or blur closes
Touch devices open on long press, which suppresses the click, and tapping outside closes
Bubble follows the trigger on scroll and resize and is clamped inside the viewport
Optional lean tilt of the bubble based on movement speed in a group
Reduced motion disables pop, rise, blur and lean
editableByProps: Tooltip content, shortcut chip and trigger element
Side, gap, size, radius, arrow, colors
Open delay, warm window, pop duration, scale and blur, long-press time
Group timing (delay, warmWindow, travel, lean) by wrapping triggers in WarmTooltipGroup

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the font sizes and padding of the size presets
Change the close grace period or content swap animation
needsCodeEdit.where: GRACE, SWAP and SWAP_SHIFT constants and the LAYER variants

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the bubble shadow or font weight
needsCodeEdit.where: className of the inner motion.span inside the portal in WarmTooltipGroup

fixed: Requires the motion package (motion/react) and React DOM portals
Renders the bubble in a portal on document.body with z-index 9999
Adds document-level pointerdown, visibilitychange and capture-phase window scroll and resize listeners while open
Children must be a single React element that accepts aria-describedby
Content is a single nowrap line, so long text can overflow narrow screens
Hover opening is ignored for touch pointers, touch relies on long press
Default colors are a light surface with dark text
Group props travel and lean are only available on WarmTooltipGroup, not on WarmTooltip
